messages:
Alana: Quick design review 1 Getting Started rail (compact). Need eyes on CTA copy + contrast/a11y. Screenshot in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz
Meena: On it. Two quick flags: CTA label options and blue pill contrast. :eyes:
Josh: Keep CTAs short. 'Try sample project' vs 'Create a sample app' 1 prefer shorter.
Tomas: Agreed on brevity. Ran a contrast check: current primary blue (#1E90FF) on white is ~3.2:1 for 14px, fails AA.
Meena: Axe flags small text links in the rail as failing.
Alana: Proposal: swap to #0B63D6 for primary CTA (should be ~4.6:1). Also bold CTA text for better legibility at small sizes.
Elana: Accessibility nit: sample thumbnails missing alt text. Should be explicit like 'Sample: Chat assistant project'.
Tomas: Also keyboard focus order is wrong: tabbing lands on dismiss icon first instead of primary CTA. Repro: tab to rail, focus order off.
Josh: Repro'd. Quick CSS to add visible focus and make CTA first tabbable item:
.rail-cta:focus { outline: 3px solid #ffbf47; outline-offset: 2px; }
.rail-item { tabindex: 0; }
We'll also reorder DOM so CTA tabbable index comes first.
Meena: I mocked three copy variants in Figma:
A) "Try sample project"
B) "Get started with a sample"
C) "Create a sample app"
Which to A/B?
Tomas: Lean B 1 explicit and pairs well with microcopy.
Alana: B works. Add a screen-reader-only header: 'Getting started: sample projects'.
Meena: Will update Figma and push a branch with color swap + alt text + copy B. Will run Lighthouse and paste results.
Alana: Also add 'Skip onboarding' for users who want to dismiss permanently. Use aria-controls and persist preference.
Elana: +1. Ensure dismiss control has aria-pressed state.
Josh: I'll pick up frontend changes tomorrow. Pinged #eng-frontend.
devex-bot: Deploy preview created: https://deploy-preview.example.com/getting-started-rail-contrast (branch: getting-started-rail-contrast)
Tomas: Preview looks better: focus ring and contrast OK. Noted mobile spacing issue: gap between thumbnail and title is 6px but should be 8px.
Meena: I'll fix spacing in next commit and re-run accessibility checks.
Alana: Send updated preview link here and we'll merge after spacing tweak. Thanks everyone :pray:
